title_zh: 安排记录菜畦产量并辨认不熟悉的植物

scenario.label_zh: 安排记录菜畦产量并辨认不熟悉的植物
scenario.goal_zh: 区分产量记录与生长原因推测并约定先辨认不熟悉的植物

context_zh: 两位社区园艺爱好者整理自家共用菜畦的记录，并看见一株尚未辨认的植物。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: The beans seem to thrive in this bed. Is this where we used the new compost?

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: It is, but we changed the watering too. We can't tell which change mattered.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: The yield was three kilos last week. I'll put that in the notebook without claiming a cause.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: Good. Keep the weight separate from our guesses.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: What about this little plant? Is it a weed or something we planted?

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I'm not sure. Let's take a photo and ask the gardening group before pulling it out.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: All right. I'll leave it where it is for now.
